notes.title: Demo update
notes.content:
The [b]HeroSquare[/b] playable demo offers you a lot to chew on!
The demo can take most people 1-2 hours to complete (and even more if you're really exhaustive about it!).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44151766/b28421ce5e368000c93165961b3bc8b52d162941.png[/img]

The game has acquired a lot of polish since the last demo release. This demo is now based on the closed playtest version and thus includes several months worth of improvements, bug fixes and playtest feedback.

I really hope you enjoy! 😊

[b]Full game to release later in 2025![/b]

notes.title: HeroSquare has a BRAND NEW DEMO!
notes.content:
Hi all!

There's a new demo available starting from right now! 
I feel this demo represents the final game very well, and it features:
[list]
[*] several boss battles 👾
[*] branching path metroidvania gameplay, with action & exploration
[*] secrets to discover, including a hidden item shop ^^
[*] colorful retro visuals and original chiptune soundtrack
[/list]
[previewyoutube=hF6D7ST9jF0;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]

I hope you like it!

notes.title: HeroSquare Demo is 1-2 hours of FREE metroidvania content!
notes.content:
Hi there!

HeroSquare Demo is finally out! With this demo I really wanted to give you something that feels like a complete experience in itself :)

In the Demo you will find among other things:

[list]
[*] 1-2 hours of metroidvania adventure
[*] large map full of puzzles and enemies
[*] 3 unique boss fights
[*] fun retro presentation with an original chiptune OST
[*] secrets and cryptic clues...maybe they lead somewhere?
[/list]
[previewyoutube=Li6iH90UrRI;full][/previewyoutube]


🕹️🌈 I really hope you enjoy it! 🕹️🌈



💎 p.s. if you find all 8 diamonds, let me know!
